verdict.rationale: Call forwarding is a core axis for a cloud phone system, but the evidence never documents forwarding the business number to an external cell phone. The closest items are IVR routing with business-hours scheduling, developer tutorials for overflow and do-not-disturb systems, and AI agents for after-hours calls. These are adjacent features or developer building blocks, not the forwarding capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, I can forward the business number to a cell when the team is away from the desk
